session_note: Cloud-agent session on branch claude/pollard-rho-gpu-parallelization-dk129f, 2026-09-16, on user instruction to record the seed scheme and progress figures of the Bailey et al. ECC2K-130 computation. KN-LIT-096 was written from the paper's introduction and platform tables and says whether the challenge was solved 'was not established here'; KN-TECH-036 lists ECC2K-130 as an estimate, not a completion. The paper, two author talk decks carrying dated server tallies, and the project status page with its bytes-received graph were fetched so the seed/report design and the collected-work figures are cited from frozen bytes.

attempts.purpose: Freeze the full text of Bailey et al., Breaking ECC2K-130, IACR ePrint 2009/541
attempts.reason: Primary source for the iteration function, seed-to-start-point derivation, report format (s, h) and central-server design (Section 3, Appendix C, Appendix D). ePrint's Last-Modified is 2009-11-18; the ePrint listing may carry later revisions, which were not compared.
attempts.revision_id: PDF served by eprint.iacr.org on 2026-09-16, 20 pages, server Last-Modified 2009-11-18.

attempts.purpose: Author talk deck whose 'Reports so far' slide gives per-site byte tallies from the servers dated 2010.10.22
attempts.reason: Author-posted slides (Tanja Lange, 'Breaking ECC2K-130', Beamer, 59 overlay pages) on the author's talks page; the tallies slide is the only dated per-site record of collected reports found. Not an open licence; frozen for verification, not redistribution.
attempts.revision_id: Server Last-Modified 2011-08-12; the tallies slide is dated 2010.10.22 in its own title.

attempts.purpose: Earlier deck of the same talk whose 'Reports so far' slide gives tallies dated 2010.09.07, giving a second dated point and a rate
attempts.reason: Author-posted slides (Tanja Lange, 'Attacking Elliptic Curve Challenges', Beamer, 40 overlay pages). Not an open licence; frozen for verification, not redistribution.
attempts.revision_id: Server Last-Modified 2010-09-08, one day after the tallies date on the slide.

attempts.purpose: Project status page: DP cutoff statement (2^25.27 iterations per DP, 2^60.9 total, 2^35.63 DPs), platform speed table, and the link to the bytes-received graph
attempts.reason: The page text has not changed since 2010-03-14 per the server's Last-Modified; it still reads 'We are still in the phase where we see new clusters join'. Frozen because the page reports no number in text, only via the graph image.

attempts.purpose: The 'Number of bytes received by the servers' timeline graph, the only record of the computation's progress after the 2010-10-22 tallies
attempts.reason: 1024x768 gnuplot-style PNG; x-axis dates 2009-11-02 to 2011-08-22, y-axis 0 to 1.6e11 bytes; last plotted point about 1.43e11 bytes. The value is read by eye (no data file is served: /data, /dps.txt, /stats.txt, /graph.dat all 404) and is therefore bracketed in KN-LIT-661e97. The server's Last-Modified of 2011-09-02 is the last time the graph was regenerated.

attempts.purpose: Archived copy of the status page, to see whether the page ever reported a later figure or an end of the computation
attempts.method: WebFetch and curl via the session's egress proxy
attempts.evidence: Both the 2014-12-31 and 2019-12-06 snapshots the Wayback availability API reported were refused: 'Blocked by egress policy'. The live page (Last-Modified 2010-03-14) was used instead; no later text version was seen.

attempts.purpose: The project's news feed, linked from the status page and both decks
attempts.evidence: Not fetchable from this session; whether it announced an end to the computation is unknown here.
